_comment: Upstream API routes this Cloudflare deployment deliberately does not serve, by path prefix, with why. The app treats them as an upstream server with that feature turned off. pnpm check:upstream flags any upstream route that is neither served by worker/src nor covered here. Keep reasons short; docs/cloudflare-migration/STAYING_UP_TO_DATE.md explains them.

prefixes./api/account/email: password and email sign-in are off (passkeys only)
prefixes./api/media/: photos and videos of custom exercises are off (needs R2)
prefixes./api/push/: Web Push in the browser is off (the phone apps notify on their own)
prefixes./api/watch/: the server watch relay is off (the phone apps sync their watches directly)
prefixes./api/integrations/oauth/: only the webhook integration is offered (no OAuth providers)
